messages:
June (Content): Drafting the launch blog — included a benchmark highlight and webinar CTA in the hero. Need quick passes: Legal on claims, Demand Gen on gating + HS form fields, Growth on headline variants, Ops on publish timing. Can folks glance today? :dart:
Owen (Product): Paste the benchmark sentence so I can confirm the baseline and infra details.
June (Content): Current line:
"In our tests, Redwood Inference lowered per-token serving cost by as much as 39% versus a stock PyTorch FP16 baseline on long-context (8k) workloads; methodology linked below."
Hero CTA: "See the demo + register for the webinar".
Priya (Legal): Good that it's hedged. Please add a methodology link and disclose hardware/commands in the appendix. Prefer wording: "up to 39% in our tests" and change the quality clause to "while maintaining comparable automated-evaluation metrics (see methodology)".
Marco (Demand Gen): Recommend gating the benchmark slides and making the recording public after. HubSpot snippet I need in the draft:

```
formId: "hs_ri_launch_sep26"
hiddenFields: ["utm_source","utm_campaign","product_interest","company_size"]
redirect: "/thanks/launch-slides"
```

Also need webinar date to plan promos.
Tess (Growth): Headline A/B ideas: (A) "Lower inference cost, predictable latency" vs (B) "Production LLM inference that scales". Add CTA UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=ri_launch to split test.
Riley (Ops): Proposed publish Tue 2026-09-21 09:00 PT; embargo 08:30 PT. I'll run HS form staging test Mon 16:00 PT. Need final permalink and OG image.
June (Content): Timeline: lock copy Mon EOD; legal signoff Tue AM; demand-gen builds Tue PM; ops preflight Mon 16:00; publish Tue 09:00 PT. Suggested permalink: /blog/redwood-inference-launch-q3.
Priya (Legal): I'll sign off once the appendix link is live on the draft page and the language is updated.
Owen (Product): I'll upload the runbook with hardware, commands, seeds and model variants (A10G, batch=1, seq=8192, seed=42).
Marco (Demand Gen): Modal copy: "Get the benchmark slides + ops checklist". I'll QA after Ops test.
Tess (Growth): Confirmed A/B; will add variants to CMS after copy lock.
Riley (Ops): Staging form test scheduled Mon 16:00 PT; will post results here. publish-bot: Publish job queued: 2026-09-21T09:00:00-07:00 (blog/redwood-inference-launch-q3).
June (Content): Thanks all — please react when your item is done so I can close the thread. :rocket:
